test_case.test_name: Parameterized MLPerf GPT-J 99.9 high-accuracy Server validation
test_case.purpose: Produce a compliant GPT-J99.9 high-accuracy Server result and compare it with a matched MLCommons v4.0 reference.
required_package: Licensed v4.0 harness/LoadGen/container and GPT-J99.9 model/data/calibration/config
Server schedule, latency target and high-accuracy/validity settings
Comparable reference and approved score delta
test_case.test_command: Validate artifacts, licenses, GPU health and supported configuration; execute the release-supported equivalent of `make run RUN_ARGS="--benchmarks=gptj --scenarios=server --config_ver=high_accuracy"`; preserve accuracy, LoadGen validity/detail/summary, throughput/P99 and telemetry; restore settings and compare only with the bound GPT-J99.9 Server reference.
test_case.expected_result: GPT-J99.9 high-accuracy and Server validity pass; throughput/latency meets the approved reference delta; platform stays healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact GPT-J99.9 high_accuracy Server identity, compliant accuracy/validity and approved comparison. GPT-J99, BERT, Offline, invalid or thresholdless results cannot pass.
safety_gate: Verify high_accuracy Server identity before launch.
Abort on validity or health limits.
Preserve all logs and do not claim official submission status.
test_case.recovery: Stop invalid/unhealthy runs, preserve evidence, remove only test-created state, restore runtime/power settings and verify all GPUs before any new approval.
